title: The Whispering Manor
premise: A letter from a frightened apprentice calls you to Vask Manor, where the inventor Ottoline Vask vanished while chasing a phenomenon called the Echo.
introLines: The letter arrived on a night without wind. It asked for one thing: finish what Ottoline Vask began.
Vask Manor waits on the hill. The gate opens before you knock.
Somewhere inside, a voice repeats your footsteps a heartbeat late.

characters.name: Tallow
characters.voice: Courteous and dry. Careful, old-fashioned sentences.

characters.name: Ottoline Vask
characters.voice: Brisk, curious and warm. Teases herself in her notes.

characters.name: Wren Dabney
characters.voice: Anxious and honest. Short, breathless lines.

characters.name: Edric Maul
characters.voice: Silky and patient. Every kindness has a price.

characters.name: The Echo
characters.voice: Repeats the last words it hears, bent a little each time.

endings.title: A Quiet Dawn
epilogue: You lower the last ring. One by one, the voices in the vault fall silent.
Ottoline's laugh is the final sound, warm and unhurried. Then, nothing.
At sunrise Tallow winds his own key and sweeps the hall. The manor is merely old now.

endings.title: The Homecoming
epilogue: You call her name into the engine, and the Echo answers with a heartbeat.
Ottoline steps out of the mirrored dark, ink on her fingers, a year of silence in her eyes.
The Echo shrinks to a whisper in the walls, content to be a friend.
Tallow offers her a lantern. 'Welcome home, madam. The library is dark.'

endings.title: The Keeper's Chair
epilogue: You bind the Echo as Maul instructed. Every voice it ever swallowed bows to your own.
The manor's doors open for you and close for everyone else.
In the vault, a chair of stone waits. Somewhere, Ottoline whispers your words back to you, bent.
You are not alone anymore. You never will be again.
